mapper.select: SELECT cp.plan_id, cp.plan_name, g.greenhouse_name, c.crop_name, c.variety_name, cp.planned_start_date, cp.planned_end_date, cp.actual_start_date, cp.actual_end_date, cp.plan_status, cp.end_reason FROM cultivation_plan AS cp JOIN greenhouse AS g ON g.greenhouse_id = cp.greenhouse_id JOIN crop_stage_standard AS css ON css.standard_id = cp.standard_id JOIN crop AS c ON c.crop_id = css.crop_id WHERE cp.member_id = #{memberId} AND cp.plan_id = #{planId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cultivation_plan ( greenhouse_id, member_id, standard_id, plan_name, plan_status, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, created_at ) VALUES ( #{greenhouseId}, #{memberId}, #{standardId}, #{planName}, '미진행', #{plannedStartDate}, #{plannedEndDate}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE cultivation_plan SET plan_name = #{planName}, planned_start_date = #{plannedStartDate}, planned_end_date = #{plannedEndDate} WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND plan_id = #{planId}
UPDATE cultivation_plan SET actual_start_date = NOW(), plan_status = '진행' WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND plan_id = #{planId}
UPDATE cultivation_plan SET actual_end_date = NOW(), plan_status = '종료', end_reason = #{endReason} WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND plan_id = #{planId}
